Chapter 27: Buying a Car When Happiness Came Too Suddenly

Lin Fan looked at the two of them and wanted to laugh.

Step, step.

At this moment, Ma Zhong slowly walked in with a few books in his arms.

After he put down the book, he casually flipped through his phone.

“There’s actually a Lamborghini Aventador at our school!” he exclaimed in surprise.

“Lamborghini Aventador?!” When Song Yi heard this, he immediately perked up and said excitedly, “Is it really a Lamborghini Aventador? Are you sure?”

Song Yi loved cars, especially supercars.

Lamborghini was also a top-tier noble among the supercars.

It was no wonder he was so excited.

Ma Zhong said, “Someone posted a photo on Tieba…”

“Hurry up and show me!” Song Yi said impatiently.

Zheng Jinbao also leaned his head over.

“It’s really a Lamborghini Aventador! Oh my God!” Song Yi shouted in excitement.

“I wonder which godly tycoon it is. If I had this car, I might be able to get the twins’ attention, right?” Zheng Jinbao said. “Hey, there are photos of the tycoon below. Quick, let’s see if he’s as handsome as me.”

In the next moment, Song Yi, Zheng Jinbao, and Ma Zhong’s expressions all froze.

That was because the photo of the godly tycoon was Lin Fan!

Song Yi said, “L-Lin Fan, the owner of the Lamborghini Aventador…”

“It’s mine,” Lin Fan said with a smile.

“Heavens! Are you thinking of killing me from the shock? Not only did you win the basketball match, but the twins also bought you drinks and asked for your WeChat. Now, you even have the Lamborghini car that all men dream of! Lin Fan, if you don’t let me call you ‘Brother Fan’, I’ll kneel down in front of you right now!” Song Yi shouted.

Zheng Jinbao shouted, “Beauties and a sports car! My fragile heart has already been severely injured. Brother Fan, now, only a big meal can soothe my injured heart.”

“I told you guys yesterday that I would treat you guys to a big meal, but you insisted on going for a barbecue,” Lin Fan said with a smile.

Zheng Jinbao laughed awkwardly. “Well, the barbecue was just to fill our stomachs,” he said.

Yesterday, Lin fan had indeed said that he wanted to treat the three of them to a good meal.

However, Zheng Jinbao was worried that Lin Fan would spend too much.

That was why they insisted on eating at the barbecue stall.

Lin Fan laughed. “I happen to want to buy a car. Why don’t we do this? Let’s go buy a car first. Then, we’ll have a big meal together!”

Song Yi asked, “Don’t you have a Lamborghini?” Why do you still want to buy a car?”

“That car…” Lin Fan said, “I need to buy a bigger car.”

“What car do you want to buy?” Song Yi asked again.

“Mercedes-Benz G-Class,” Lin Fan said.

“I’m going to kneel in front of Brother Fan.” Song Yi, Zheng Jinbao, and Ma Zhong said in unison.

…

There were only two seats in the Lamborghini, but there were four people in the dormitory.

Therefore, Lin Fan chose to take a taxi to the Mercedes-Benz shop.

This made Song Yi feel like a child who was walking past a toy store but was forcefully pulled away by an adult. His face was full of reluctance.

He had wanted to use this opportunity to experience the awesome Lamborghini.

It was only when Lin Fan said that he could let him drive his Lamborghini in the future that Song Yi immediately smiled.

When Lin Fan and the rest walked into the well-decorated and luxurious Mercedes-Benz 4S shop, a salesperson immediately came up to them.

As a top brand, the price of Mercedes-Benz was extremely high for ordinary people.

However, the salesperson did not treat Lin Fan and the others with any disrespect just because they looked like students.

“Welcome to Mercedes-Benz,” he said with a smile.

“Is there anything I can help you with?”

After Song Yi, Zheng Jinbao, and Ma Zhong entered the 4S store, they looked around.

Song Yi, in particular, ran directly to the front of a cool and grand Mercedes-Benz car and gently stroked it.

“This is the latest Mercedes-Benz E350,” the salesperson introduced. “It has 299 horsepower, and its appearance is steady, but it doesn’t lose out on its strength. It’s very suitable for young people like you.

“Of course, if you don’t have too many requirements for the horsepower, I recommend you to consider the E260. It looks exactly the same as the E350.

“The E260 has 184 horsepower. Be it the acceleration or comfort, this model is also very good. The price-performance ratio is far higher than the E350.”

Most salespeople would love to let their customers buy expensive products.

However, this salesperson took the initiative to analyze things clearly for the customer as if they were friends who had known each other for a long time.

Song Yi touched the back of his head in embarrassment and said, “I’m sorry, I’ve wasted your time. I’m just looking around. He’s the one who’s here to buy a car.”

As he spoke, he pointed at Lin Fan.

The salesperson was not annoyed at all and said, “It’s not a waste of time. Now that you know about our Mercedes-Benz cars, you might just come and buy one in the future.”

Then, he smiled at Lin Fan and asked, “Fo you have a car that you like? I can introduce it to you.”

“G-Class,” Lin fan replied.

“We happen to have a new car. This way, please,” the salesperson said.

Soon, they arrived at the other side of the 4S store.

At that moment, a black G-Class, which looked like a beast, was parked in the middle.

“Woah! It’s so awesome!”

“This is the car that a true man should drive!”

Song Yi, Zheng Jinbao, and Ma Zhong were all amazed.

They had seen photos of G-Class vehicles in magazines and computers, and they also thought that they were very cool.

However, after seeing one for themselves, they were still stunned.

The salesperson said, “This is a Mercedes-Benz G500, V8, 4.0. It has a maximum power of 421 horsepower and a maximum torque of 610. With the addition of a Mature 9AT transmission, who can imagine that such a big guy can complete an acceleration of 100 kilometers in 5.9 seconds?”

The salesperson sighed.

Lin Fan said, “Is it spacious?”

“It’s very spacious! Not to mention in the same class, even in an SUV that’s one class higher, there are few that can be a match for it!”

“Alright, I’ll get this, then.” Lin Fan nodded.

After saying that, Lin Fan took out his bank card.

Seeing this, the salesperson was startled.

The salesperson could not help but be stunned.

What was going on?

‘I don’t think I’ve introduced myself yet, right?

‘And he didn’t mention the price, did he?

‘He’s going to buy it just like that?

‘Don’t you want to discuss the price?

‘Aren’t we going to discuss the free items?’

After a long time, the salesperson finally reacted and said, “I forgot to tell you that this is the G500 dark night special edition. On top of the basic G500 model, there’s a sports suit, many beam lights, and an adaptive near-far beam. It’s 230,000 yuan more expensive than the normal G500.

“If you’re willing to wait for a few days, we’ll get a normal version very soon.”

Lin Fan waved his hand. “No need. I’ll take this one.”

“Alright, alright!” the salesperson replied. “This car, including insurance, purchase tax, and other expenses, comes to a total of 2.18 million. Would you like to pay in installments or in full?”

“The full amount.” Lin Fan said, “When can I take the car away?”

The sales assistant said, “Tomorrow morning, you can come with us to the Vehicle Administration Office to get a license plate.”

Lin Fan thought for a moment. “How about this? I’ll give you 2.2 million. You help me get the plate and then send the car to my school. How about it?”

It was already very troublesome to buy a car.

Lin Fan did not want to run around again.

The salesperson was slightly taken aback, and then he excitedly said, “Alright, leave it to me!”

One had to know that this car only cost 2.18 million.

Now, the other party was offering to give him 2.2 million!

In other words, he could get a tip of 200,000 yuan just by running an errand!

Happiness came too suddenly!
